Japan is making history as Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi orders the deployment of three Ground Self-Defense Force CH-47 Chinook helicopters to Indonesia to help battle devastating forest and peatland fires across Kalimantan. The mission comes after an official request from the Indonesian government, with prolonged drought and severe El Niño conditions worsening the fires. Equipped for large-scale water drops, the powerful helicopters will also help deliver personnel and emergency supplies to areas cut off by the disaster. Around 600 Japanese Self-Defense Force personnel are expected to take part, marking the first overseas aerial firefighting operation conducted by Japan’s Self-Defense Forces. #Japan #Indonesia #JSDF #JGSDF #Chinook #CH47 #ForestFires #Kalimantan #DisasterRelief #HumanitarianMission #JapanIndonesia #BreakingNews
